jobs.title: AI-Native Creative Producer — Digital Marketing Agency (Remote) - AI Supported Processes.
jobs.description:
***If you don't have a portfolio, or clear experience, or the ability to walkthrough processes, you need not apply***

I run a creative digital marketing agency based in Ireland serving clients in the US, UK and Ireland. We produce high-volume, on-brand creative content using AI generation tools as the core of our production pipeline. I need someone who already works this way and can own the entire creative production process from brief to published content.

What this role actually is:

- You receive a creative brief or direction from me. You generate the raw assets — images, video, graphics — using AI tools.

- You composite, edit, and refine those assets into finished, on-brand marketing content. You write the copy, schedule the posts, and track performance.

- The full pipeline, from generation to publication, lives with you.

You also bring strategic thinking to the table. This isn't a role where you wait to be told what to post. We'll define the content and growth strategy together — your experience informs the direction as much as mine does. I need someone who can look at what's working, what's not, and come to the table with informed opinions on where to push next. We will work as a team to give ourselves, and our clients the best possible creative work.

This is not a role where you use AI occasionally to speed things up. AI-native creative production is the job. You should already have workflows built around these tools and be producing content this way right now. Experience, and Quality is of most importance.

Your production toolkit should include most of these:

- Image generation and refinement: Midjourney, ComfyUI, LoveArt, Flora, or equivalent.

- Video generation: Higgsfield, Kling, or similar AI video tools.

- Multimodal AI: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude for copy, ideation, and content planning.

- Editing and compositing: Canva, Figma, CapCut, DaVinci, or whatever you use to take raw AI outputs and turn them into polished, scroll-stopping content.

If you're only using ChatGPT to write captions and Canva to make templates, this isn't the right fit. I need someone who can generate a full set of brand-consistent visual assets from a brief and deliver finished content that looks like it came from a studio, not an AI prompt.

What you'll deliver:

- Social media content (graphics, short-form video, carousels, reels) across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube.

- On-brand AI-generated imagery and video assets for campaigns, ads, and organic content.

- Copy and captions that match brand voice guidelines.

- Weekly performance reports with insights, not just numbers — what worked, what didn't, what to test next.

- Light client social account management alongside agency brand content.

What I need from you:

- Proven experience producing AI-generated creative content at volume — show me the work.

- You have your own production process and you can explain it. You understand brand consistency — you can generate 50 assets and they all feel like they came from the same brand, not 50 different prompts.

- You know what performs on social and you build content with engagement in mind, not just aesthetics. with a strong understanding of growth mechanics: what drives reach, engagement, saves, shares, and ultimately conversions.

- Strategic input based on experience. You've grown accounts before, you know what levers to pull, and you can back your recommendations with reasoning and data.

We'll build the strategy together, but you need to show up with opinions worth hearing. Reliable, communicative, and self-directed. I'll give you direction, not micromanagement.

This is not:

- A learn-on-the-job position. An execution-only role where you switch your brain off and follow instructions. A set-and-forget scheduling gig.

This could become:

- A long-term creative lead role across multiple brands as the agency scales. The right person will grow with the role and have a genuine stake in the output, and hopefully lead our creative team in the future.

Hours: 15–25 hrs/week to start

Rate: $12–18/hr depending on experience and portfolio quality (we have some wiggle room for the right person)

To apply, send me three things:

- A portfolio or examples showing AI-generated creative content you've produced. not just prompts, but finished, published assets. (Mock brands are accepted but the quality must be there)

- A link to social accounts you've managed or contributed to, showing results.

- A 2-minute Loom video: pick any brand (real or fictional) and walk me through how you'd produce one week of content for them using your AI production workflow. Show me your thinking, your tools, your process.

We are entering a new phase in our business, we look forward to having one of you on board to spearhead that new growth. Thank you!

The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. • Industry: Real Estate

You'll receive 3 different scripts, each approximately 30–40 seconds long.

To help the videos feel more authentic, we encourage natural camera movement whenever it makes sense. We want the videos to look like genuine UGC, not a polished commercial.

It's perfectly okay to glance away from the camera naturally from time to time, just as you would during a normal conversation. The goal is to sound relaxed and authentic rather than feeling like you're reading from a script.

We recommend a clean, professional, business casual look.

Since each script is filmed in 3 different locations, we'd like you to wear a different shirt in each location. You can absolutely reuse the same shirts throughout the project, as long as each location has a different look. This helps make each video feel like it was filmed on different days and gives us more creative variety for testing ads.

• 3 unique scripts

• 9 raw videos total (30–40 seconds each)
